description: Read company websites by domain and return one row per site with the logo URL and source, inline SVG logo markup when the site draws it inline, the best square icon and its pixel size, favicon, Apple touch icon, share image, web app manifest, theme color and declared brand colors, plus every logo and icon candidate with its checked format and size.

domains.description: Company domains (stripe.com) or website URLs (https://www.ikea.com/us/en/). A bare domain reads its homepage. Duplicates are read once. Up to 5,000 per run. From Clay, put the domain column inside a one item list.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount, counting the run start. Summary rows are always returned.

verify_images.description: yes (default): fetch each logo and icon to confirm it loads and to read its format and pixel size, and try /favicon.ico when the page declares no icon. no: return the declared URLs without checking them, faster. Text yes or no, so Clay can send it.

name: find_website_logos
title: Find website logos
